sheets.title: Travel › Coming home, a vault with a site grant — 1280 × 900
sheets.caption: Settings › Vaults › Travel › Bring vaults home, with a real bundle whose one vault carries a site-broker consent for https://rp.example. Before, the grant was just another file of the vault: counted in its files and written back with it, unannounced, so a bundle from someone else could plant a site's permission to sign in without asking. After, the row names what the grants would let in, and they come back only if the box beneath is ticked; unticked, the vault comes home and its sites ask again.
sheets.before: row: Work · 3 files (grant counted as a vault file); checkboxes: 0
sheets.after: row: Work · 2 files · 1 site grant; checkboxes: 1 ("Let these sites in again: https://rp.example", unticked)
